english_classification.chapter_title: The Chapter on whether any [Lig]ht comes from the Three Vessels
english_classification.chapter_note: Short, predominantly substrate chapter describing the cosmological mechanism by which light is refined from the three vessels surrounding the universe. The teaching describes gates at four compass points opening downward to the vessels, light rays entering through these openings, and a purification/clarification process through the firmaments. The only editorial overlay is the standard dialogue frame attribution in paragraphs 1 and 2. No editorial bridge, institutional, or exhortation material detected. The teaching is systematic cosmic-process description — both sides of every mapping remain within the cosmic architecture (vessels, gates, firmaments, rays, light, living ones). This is a compact, well-preserved substrate teaching unit.
